WarMonitor RT @joshrogin : “Vladimir Putin must not believe his luck. He could never have imagined that here he would be, with a U.S. president who not only thinks that they're friends, but is willing to reorient US policy towards the pro-Russian position, against Ukraine, and then elevate Putin.” “Remember, this trilateral meeting was Putin's idea. So you've got the most important country in the world, the United States, the second most important country in the world, China. And then you've got this other country, Russia, which has an economy about the size of Italy's, a declining former power, and now they're all at the same level. This is a diplomatic coup for Vladimir Putin every way you slice it.” “This is not a new world order. This is bizarro world, where the President of the United States has actually put the United States on the team with Russia and China against our allies and against the Ukrainians. That's bizarre. That's unprecedented.” “The only saving grace is that it won't last. Those guys know they're not going to have it this good forever. Trump will be gone in a couple of years. The midterms showed that there's still a bipartisan consensus in the United States in Congress for a foreign policy that follows American values - or at least the values that America had for the first 200 some odd years, until a couple of years ago.” “So this too shall pass. But for right now, every day is Christmas for Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping.” tweet

OSINTdefender National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving his post, a White House official told CBS News, after Axios first reported the departure. Cairncross, an attorney who has held the Senate confirmed role since August 2025, advised the president on cybersecurity and coordinated federal cyber strategy. His exit comes after a week of outages that hit Microsoft services, FAA air traffic control, major banks and an NSA internal network. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told lawmakers that investigators have seen nothing indicating the outages are related, and said he is “98% confident” they are not the result of malicious foreign activity. The reports do not link Cairncross’s departure to the outages and no official reason for his departure has been given. Sean Cairncross was fired, sources told me. Stephen Miller had wanted him out of the job since his 1st day as chief, and immediately teed up a search process for a replacement. Miller told people he didn't think Cairncross had the expertise needed to be national cyber director. https://www.cbsnews.com/news/white-house-national-cyber-director-sean-cairncross-leaving/ - Jennifer Jacobs tweet

ထိုင်းနိုင်ငံမှာ အလုပ်လုပ်ကိုင်နေတဲ့ မြန်မာအလုပ်သမားတွေရဲ့ လုပ်ခလစာထဲက ၂၅ ရာခိုင်နှုန်းကို မြန်မာနိုင်ငံကို မဖြစ်မနေ ပြန်လွှဲပေးရမယ်ဆိုတဲ့ သတ်မှတ်ချက်ကို ထိုင်းအလုပ်သမားဝန်ကြီးက ကန့်ကွက်လိုက်ပါတယ်။ အလုပ်သမားတွေရဲ့ လုပ်ခလစာဟာ သူတို့ကိုယ်တိုင် ရရှိပိုင်ဆိုင်တဲ့ ဝင်ငွေဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် အဲဒီထဲက ငွေပမာဏတစ်ခုကို မဖြစ်မနေ ပြန်လွှဲခိုင်းတာဟာ နိုင်ငံတကာ အလုပ်သမားရေးရာ စံနှုန်းတွေနဲ့ မကိုက်ညီဘူးလို့ ထိုင်းအလုပ်သမားဝန်ကြီး ဂျူလဖန် အမော်န်ဝီဝတ်က ပြောပါတယ်။ ဒီကိစ္စအပြင် မြန်မာအလုပ်သမားတွေအတွက် နိုင်ငံသားဖြစ်မှု အထောက်အထားလက်မှတ် (CI) ထုတ်ပေးနေတဲ့ စင်တာတွေရဲ့ လုပ်ငန်းစဉ်တွေမှာ မသမာတဲ့ ငွေကြေးကောက်ခံမှုတွေ ရှိနေတယ်ဆိုတဲ့ တိုင်ကြားချက်တွေနဲ့ပတ်သက်ပြီး မြန်မာသံအမတ်ထံ တရားဝင်စာပေးပို့ကာ ဆွေးနွေးသွားမယ်လို့လည်း သူက ပြောပါတယ်။ သတင်းအပြည့်အစုံ - https://www.bbc.com/burmese/live/cqz0k399m5grt
সেদিন লারাকে মেরে ফেলেছেন ভেবেছিলেন শোয়েব আখতার — লারাকে আঘাত করার আগে তাঁকে সতর্কও করেছিলেন শোয়েব। বলেছিলেন, ‘দয়া করে আমাকে চার মেরো না। তোমাকে আমি খুব ভালোবাসি।’
